summary: The remediation adds useful structural checks, but it still permits false-passing assurance records, rejects valid Git SHA-256 repositories, and documents an accepted-exception manifest that fails its own verifier.

findings.title: An empty evidence policy accepts an unevidenced timeout
findings.trigger: Use an otherwise valid manifest whose EXPECTED_MUTATION_LIVENESS policy has allowedRawStatuses ["TIMED_OUT"] and requiredEvidence [], then record a TIMED_OUT accepted exception with evidence {} and a nonblank approvedBy under a PASS WITH ACCEPTED EXCEPTIONS final gate.
findings.consequence: The verifier accepts a passing assurance run without any focused rerun, unmutated-test result, XML/log, liveness explanation, or review evidence for the timeout.
findings.evidence: verify_run.py:338-343 accepts an empty requiredEvidence list because it checks only type and element validity. The required-category loop at verify_run.py:348-351 then performs no checks, while an empty evidence object passes verify_run.py:344-347 and no path/hash validation runs at verify_run.py:357-372.
findings.suggestedFix: Require requiredEvidence to be a non-empty list of nonblank, unique categories for every accepted exception, bind that policy to the frozen adapter snapshot, and add a regression test for an empty list.

findings.title: The inputs-only restriction can be bypassed with an output symlink
findings.trigger: Create inputs/frozen-contract.md as a symlink to ../contract.md, declare inputs/frozen-contract.md in inputs with the target's digest, and otherwise provide a valid PASS manifest.
findings.consequence: verify_run.py returns success even though a generated output artifact is presented as a frozen input, defeating the documented prohibition on output-backed inputs and the reproducibility boundary.
findings.evidence: The new check at verify_run.py:464-470 validates only the declared path string. Hashing resolves that path through verify_run.py:453-462 and safe_path at verify_run.py:229-236 only requires the resolved target to stay somewhere under the run directory, so a target such as contract.md passes.
findings.suggestedFix: After resolving each declared input, require the resolved file to remain beneath the resolved inputs directory, or reject input symlinks outright. Add a regression test for an inputs entry symlinked to a required output artifact.

findings.title: Full Git SHA-256 commit IDs are rejected
findings.trigger: Run the portable assurance skill in a Git repository using objectFormat=sha256, where git rev-parse supplies 64-character lowercase base, head, and finalHead IDs.
findings.consequence: Every otherwise valid run is rejected as having invalid full commit IDs, so the package cannot operate in a supported Git repository configuration.
findings.evidence: COMMIT_ID_RE at verify_run.py:44 permits only 40 hexadecimal characters, and verify_run.py:283-289 applies it to workspace.base, workspace.head, and finalHead. The package describes its host-adapter contract as portable in references/host-adapter.md:3-5 and does not limit Git to SHA-1 repositories.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate IDs using the repository object format, or accept both 40-character SHA-1 and 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal IDs. Add coverage using a SHA-256 object-format repository.

findings.title: The documented accepted-exception manifest omits a required input hash
findings.trigger: Follow the shown manifest shape for a TIMED_OUT exception, create the referenced inputs/pit-audit.md file, and replace the digest placeholders without adding fields not shown in the inputs map.
findings.consequence: The documented passing example fails with accepted exception evidence is not hashed: inputs/pit-audit.md, preventing users from producing the advertised accepted-liveness-exception run.
findings.evidence: The example declares only inputs/contract-source.md in its inputs map at reproducible-runs.md:51, but the newly mapped evidence references inputs/pit-audit.md at reproducible-runs.md:79-81. verify_run.py:352-372 requires every evidence path to be a key in inputs or artifacts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add inputs/pit-audit.md and its digest to the example's inputs map, ensure all shown evidence files are represented in the layout, and validate the documentation example with a regression test.
